parsed.rationale: All 11 members are unnamed extensions (name: "") on `EnvironmentValues` — a SwiftUI-idiomatic pattern where each feature module adds its own `EnvironmentValues` extension in its own file and package. The participating files span five unrelated packages (`AppServices`, `Playback`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, `PlayerHeaderView`) and cover domain concepts as diverse as playlist service injection (`PlaylistServiceEnvironment.swift`), wallpaper blend modes (`PlaybackBlendMode.swift`, `MaterialBlendMode.swift`), and accent-color theming (`AccentColorEnvironment.swift`). The structural collision is purely a consequence of the SwiftUI convention that every `EnvironmentKey`-backed value is registered via `extension EnvironmentValues`; the extensions themselves are intentionally separate and domain-specific. Consolidating them would couple unrelated packages and violate the module-boundary design already in place.
